idea-plugin.name: K8s Label-Selector Exposure Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a Deployment/Pod/StatefulSet/DaemonSet that is Service-exposed but NOT matched by any NetworkPolicy's Ingress-covering podSelector, even though NetworkPolicies exist elsewhere in the project -- the real, documented Kubernetes failure pattern where a team believes NetworkPolicy protects the namespace, but this specific workload silently falls outside every one of them.

Built on a real label-selector resolution index across EVERY YAML manifest in the project, implementing actual Kubernetes set-based selector semantics (matchLabels AND equality, plus matchExpressions with In/NotIn/Exists) -- never a substring/text match, and never bounded to one manifest.

Not a real YAML parser -- an indentation-based micro-scanner, same discipline as this catalog's other Kubernetes plugins, extended to walk nested key paths (spec.template.metadata.labels, spec.podSelector.matchExpressions).

Stated honestly: v0.1 treats the whole project as one flat namespace (an explicit metadata.namespace: isn't cross-checked -- the safe direction, never over-flagging); an unsupported selector operator (DoesNotExist) is treated as satisfied rather than guessed.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Workload exposed by Service but uncovered by any NetworkPolicy
